name: slicc
description: Write gem5 Ruby cache coherence protocols like you write C++: SLICC completion, navigation, diagnostics and inlay hints.

commands.title: SLICC: Go to Related Transitions / Calls / Usages

slicc.diagnostics.enabled.description: Report SLICC syntax and unresolved symbols.

slicc.diagnostics.members.description: Check member names when the receiver and its interface hierarchy are known.

slicc.diagnostics.functionResults.description: Check definite type mismatches involving function results.

slicc.diagnostics.externalTypes.description: Check external types against reachable gem5 C++ sources.

slicc.diagnostics.printf.description: Check DPRINTF debug flags and literal DPRINTF/DPRINTFN format argument counts.

slicc.diagnostics.transitions.description: Check transition action names and duplicate state/event pairs in include expansion order.

slicc.diagnostics.calls.description: Report definitely missing visible free or supported scoped function names.

slicc.inlayHints.parameterNames.description: Show parameter names at resolved calls.

slicc.inlayHints.implicitTypes.description: Show the type at the first use of an implicit message or action variable.

slicc.navigation.maxStatementLength.description: Maximum Unicode characters in related usage previews.

slicc.index.exclude.description: Glob excluded from workspace SLICC discovery.

slicc.index.includePaths.description: Additional include directories, absolute or relative to each workspace folder.
